name: It's a Wonderful World
summary: Empire-building card drafting game where players recycle or construct developments to produce resources and score points.
rules_text: Game lasts 4 rounds. Each round has 3 phases, all simultaneous. Draft: deal 7 development cards to each player. Each player picks 1 face-down, passes remaining left in odd rounds, right in even, then reveals. Repeat until 7 cards drafted. Planning: for each drafted card choose to recycle it for immediate resource placed on empire or on a card under construction, or slate it for construction in your construction area. Production: resolve 5 resource types in fixed order. For current type, count production icons in your empire (constructed developments plus empire card). Player with highest alone gains supremacy bonus character. Gain that many cubes from supply and place them on cards under construction or empire. Cubes on empire cannot later be used except 5 of any type convert to 1 wild Krystallium. When a card's cost spaces are filled, return cubes, gain its bonus, move it to empire so it produces next steps. After 5 steps, next round. After round 4, highest victory points on empire wins.
rating_reason: Card drafting with resource production, fits hidden hands and arithmetic ranking.
